papers.title: Towards intelligent geospatial data discovery: a knowledge graph-driven multi-agent framework powered by large language models
papers.title_zh: 迈向智能地理空间数据发现：一种由大语言模型驱动的知识图谱多智能体框架
papers.venue: International Journal of Geographical Information Science
papers.reason: 该研究将知识图谱、多智能体与大语言模型结合，用于智能地理空间数据发现，与博士研究方向中的LLM和多智能体、时空数据挖掘及地理空间智能高度吻合。
papers.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种由大语言模型驱动的知识图谱多智能体框架，旨在解决地理空间数据发现中的智能化问题。通过整合知识图谱的结构化知识和多智能体的协作能力，框架旨在提升对复杂地理空间数据查询和理解的能力。
papers.insight_zh: 结合知识图谱与多智能体，并利用大语言模型的推理能力，为地理空间数据发现提供了一种新的智能化范式，有望显著提升数据检索的效率和准确性。

papers.title: SVI2LoD3: Agent-Driven Reconstruction of LoD3 Facade Openings in Semantic 3D City Models from Volunteered Street View Imagery using Large Language and Visual Models
papers.title_zh: SVI2LoD3：利用众包街景影像和大型语言与视觉模型进行LoD3立面开口的智能体驱动重建
papers.reason: 该研究直接面向3D城市模型（CityGML LoD3）的立面开口重建，利用LLM和视觉基础模型实现零样本分割，与城市更新、LLM和多智能体以及多源数据融合的研究方向高度契合。
papers.abstract: This paper presents an end-to-end, agent-driven pipeline for the LoD3 reconstruction of facade openings in 3D city models, producing directly usable CityGML-conform outputs. In contrast to existing approaches that rely on supervised semantic segmentation and therefore require large amounts of manually annotated training data, the proposed method employs a zero-shot segmentation strategy. This substantially reduces the annotation effort while still achieving strong performance in our benchmark on the eTRIMS dataset. A further key contribution is the enforcement of correct partonomic hierarchies, thereby producing CityGML-conform LoD3 building models. Beyond the reconstruction pipeline itself, this work also introduces a novel evaluation metric for facade reconstruction, termed Facade Feature Distance (FFD). Unlike conventional metrics such as mIoU or FRDS, which assess similarity primarily through pixel-wise overlap, FFD measures distance in a high-level feature space derived from a vision transformer. In doing so, it captures both semantic correctness and architectural layout, providing a more suitable assessment of facade reconstruction quality. The proposed pipeline and evaluation strategy together offer a practical and scalable contribution toward the automated generation and analysis of semantically enriched 3D city models. The developed code is published at: https://github.com/hcu-cml/citydb-SVI2LoD3-ai.
papers.summary_zh: 提出了一种端到端的、智能体驱动的流程，用于在3D城市模型中重建LoD3级别的立面开口，并生成可直接使用的符合CityGML标准的输出。与依赖监督式语义分割的方法不同，该方法采用零样本分割策略，大大减少了标注工作，同时在eTRIMS数据集上取得了强劲的性能。另一个关键贡献是强制执行正确的部分-整体层级关系，从而生成符合CityGML标准的LoD3建筑模型。此外，还引入了一种新的立面重建评估指标，称为立面特征距离（FFD），该指标在由视觉Transformer导出的高级特征空间中测量距离，同时捕捉语义正确性和建筑布局。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究展示了利用LLM和视觉基础模型构建智能体流程，从非专业采集的街景影像中自动生成符合标准的高细节（LoD3）城市模型，为城市更新中的建筑信息自动化提取与三维城市数据库建设提供了一种可扩展的低成本解决方案。

papers.title: PointGauss: Point Cloud-Guided Multi-Object Segmentation for Gaussian Splatting
papers.title_zh: PointGauss：用于高斯泼溅的点云引导多目标分割
papers.reason: 该研究直接面向遥感与城市应用中的3D场景理解，提出基于3D高斯泼溅的语义与实例分割框架，与博士研究方向中的城市更新、多源数据融合和地理空间智能高度相关。
papers.abstract: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has established new standards for high-fidelity 3D scene modeling, interpreting massive, unstructured Gaussian primitives into meaningful geospatial entities remains a critical challenge for remote sensing and urban applications. Existing 2D-to-3D distillation methods suffer from projection ambiguities, geometric inconsistencies, and computational bottlenecks when applied to complex, large-scale topographies. Furthermore, current benchmarks lack natively aligned 2D-3D ground truth tailored for splatting-based representations. To address these limitations, we propose \textit{PointGauss}, a unified 3D-native framework for robust semantic parsing and instance segmentation. By treating Gaussian primitives as unstructured point sets, PointGauss leverages Point Transformer V3 (PTv3) to extract scale-invariant geometric features directly from Gaussian attributes, effectively resolving projection ambiguities. To ensure scalability in building-scale scenes, we introduce an adaptive region-of-interest cropping strategy and an instance-aware distance-constrained rasterization pipeline for pixel-level, view-consistent projection. Additionally, we present \textbf{SplatSeg-360}, the first rigorous cross-scale benchmark tailored for 3DGS, comprising 32 complex scenes with full 360$^\circ$ coverage and over 6,300 natively aligned 2D-3D masks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PointGauss operates in real-time and achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, it attains approximately 90\% 3D-mIoU in large-scale building scenarios and roughly 80\% 2D-mIoU in view-consistent 2D instance segmentation, outperforming baseline methods by 16\%. (\href{https://github.com/hbycswt/pointgauss#}{Code})
papers.summary_zh: 针对3D高斯泼溅在复杂大规模地形中难以解析为地理空间实体的问题，提出PointGauss框架。该框架将高斯原语视为非结构化点集，利用Point Transformer V3提取几何特征，并引入自适应感兴趣区域裁剪和实例感知的距离约束光栅化流程，实现像素级、视角一致的投影。同时构建了SplatSeg-360基准，包含32个复杂场景和超过6300个原生对齐的2D-3D掩码。实验表明，该方法在建筑级场景中达到约90%的3D-mIoU，在2D实例分割中达到约80%的2D-mIoU，性能优于基线方法16%。
papers.insight_zh: 将3D高斯泼溅原语直接作为点集处理，可有效避免2D到3D蒸馏中的投影歧义，为大规模城市级3D场景的语义解析提供了新思路，其跨尺度基准也为后续研究提供了重要参考。

papers.title: Improving text–image alignment for referring remote sensing image segmentation guided by vision foundation model
papers.title_zh: 基于视觉基础模型引导的遥感图像指代分割文本-图像对齐改进
papers.venue: International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation
papers.reason: 该研究主题为遥感图像指代分割，旨在提升文本与图像的对齐，直接涉及多模态数据融合和遥感图像理解，与博士研究方向中的多源数据融合与地理空间智能高度契合。
papers.summary_zh: 该论文针对遥感图像指代分割任务中文本与图像对齐不佳的问题，提出利用视觉基础模型进行引导的改进方法。研究旨在通过增强视觉基础模型的特征，提升模型对文本描述与图像区域间对应关系的理解，从而改善分割精度。
papers.insight_zh: 利用视觉基础模型作为引导，是提升遥感图像指代分割中跨模态对齐性能的有效途径，对复杂地理空间场景的精细解译具有重要意义。

papers.title: Harness-RL: Black-Box Reinforcement Learning with Action-Args Decoupling for Central-Agent Multi-Agent Harnesses
papers.title_zh: Harness-RL：面向中心化多智能体框架的基于动作-参数解耦的黑盒强化学习
papers.reason: 该研究针对中心化多智能体框架中的强化学习训练挑战，提出动作与参数解耦的优化方法，与用户对LLM和多智能体的研究兴趣高度契合，其方法论可直接应用于地理空间任务的多智能体协作与决策优化。
papers.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly solve long-horizon tasks through multi-agent harnesses in which a central agent coordinates specialized sub-agents, tools, and environments. Training the central policy in such a harness raises two challenges. First, an action label is a low-cardinality decision, whereas its args form a high-dimensional conditional sequence; optimizing both with a shared sequence-level signal can produce conflicting gradients. Second, dynamic scheduling creates interdependent sessions with branches, parallel calls, and rewritten contexts, which cannot be faithfully reduced to one flat token sequence. We introduce Harness-RL, a structured reinforcement learning framework that combines Conflict-Aware Policy Optimization (CAPO) with interface-level black-box trajectory construction. The black-box component captures Interface Call Records, builds per-session prefix trees, and aligns outcome and process rewards with trainable tokens. CAPO uses forward activations to identify parameter partitions associated with action and args tokens, then routes their policy gradients to the corresponding subspaces. Harness-RL supports both central-only and joint multi-agent training. Across seven multi-hop question answering and agentic retrieval benchmarks, it reaches average F1 scores of 42.93 and 47.79 with Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-3B, respectively, while ablations validate the contribution of CAPO and favor central-only optimization in the evaluated setting. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiangxinke/Harness-RL.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出Harness-RL，一个用于训练中心化多智能体框架中中心策略的结构化强化学习框架。它包含冲突感知策略优化（CAPO）和接口级黑盒轨迹构建。CAPO通过前向激活识别与动作和参数令牌相关的参数分区，并分别路由策略梯度。黑盒组件捕获接口调用记录，构建会话前缀树，并对齐结果和过程奖励。在七个多跳问答和智能体检索基准上，该方法取得了有竞争力的F1分数。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提出的动作与参数解耦优化策略，有效解决了中心化多智能体训练中的梯度冲突问题，为地理空间分析中复杂多智能体系统的训练提供了新的技术路径。

papers.title: Lightweight Adaptation of General-Purpose VLMs for Multispectral and SAR Image Understanding
papers.title_zh: 通用视觉语言模型用于多光谱和SAR图像理解的轻量化适配
papers.reason: 该研究探索了通用视觉语言模型在多光谱和SAR图像理解中的轻量化适配，直接涉及多源遥感数据融合和基础模型应用，与博士研究方向中的多源数据融合与地理空间智能高度相关。
papers.abstract: General-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) now support strong visual recognition, instruction following, and generation. However, most pretrained visual encoders are built around three-channel natural images and do not directly accommodate observations such as native multispectral measurements or synthetic aperture radar (SAR). Adapting VLMs to these sensors typically requires dedicated encoders and domain pretraining, slowing the reuse of stronger general-purpose checkpoints. We show that the multi-image interface of general-purpose VLMs offers a lightweight alternative. Our protocol renders each observation as five optical views and one SAR view, names them in the prompt, and adapts the language network and selected visual transformer blocks with LoRA. This exposes band composites, spectral indices, and radar backscatter through an existing visual interface. For land-cover recognition, structured supervision couples predicted classes with sensor evidence. We further construct preference pairs in which a true label is omitted while its supporting evidence is retained, encouraging complete predictions that remain consistent with the observations. On a balanced six-class land-cover benchmark derived from BigEarthNet-v2, the adapted Qwen3-VL reaches 0.8275 micro F1. The same input and adaptation protocol improves all four tested VLM architectures and transfers to Sen1Floods11 flood verification and BigEarthNet.txt captioning. Image removal and mismatch controls show that the adapted models use the supplied sensor observations. Together, these results demonstrate that VLMs can be repurposed for multispectral and SAR tasks through rendered inputs and compact LoRA adaptation, without training a new foundation model.
papers.summary_zh: 针对通用视觉语言模型难以直接处理多光谱和SAR数据的问题，提出一种轻量级适配协议。该方法将每个观测渲染为五个光学视图和一个SAR视图，并在提示中命名，通过LoRA适配语言网络和部分视觉Transformer块。在BigEarthNet-v2衍生的六类土地覆盖基准上，适配后的Qwen3-VL达到0.8275的micro F1，且该协议能提升所有四种测试VLM架构的性能，并迁移至洪水验证和图像描述任务。
papers.insight_zh: 通过渲染输入和紧凑的LoRA适配，可以有效地将通用视觉语言模型的能力迁移到多光谱和SAR遥感任务中，无需从头训练新模型，为多源遥感数据理解提供了高效的新路径。

papers.title: InsightSeg: Reusing Correction Insights for Guideline-Consistent Segmentation
papers.title_zh: InsightSeg：利用修正洞察实现符合准则的分割
papers.reason: 该研究提出了一种基于LLM的多智能体细化系统，通过情景记忆机制提升符合准则的语义分割性能，与LLM和多智能体以及城市更新中的地理空间智能高度相关，其方法可迁移至城市遥感影像分析。
papers.abstract: Guideline-consistent semantic segmentation requires more than category recognition, as real-world labeling policies demand fine-grained, task-specific decisions. Recent multi-agent refinement systems improve compliance with such textual guidelines by detecting and correcting errors. However, they are stateless: feedback from the critiquing agent is discarded, causing the same guideline-specific mistakes to be repeatedly rediscovered and corrected across the dataset at the cost of additional refinement. We introduce InsightSeg, an episodic memory mechanism that converts successful correction episodes into reusable, visually grounded insights. A meta-analyzer distills each qualifying episode into directive natural-language insights and anchors them to the local image regions that caused the error using patch-level visual concept vectors. On subsequent images, these concepts are matched against dense patch embeddings to retrieve relevant insights, which condition the segmenting agent before making its first prediction. This shifts the system from correcting recurring errors to preventing them, improving segmentation quality before any refinement occurs. Across Waymo and Cityscapes, InsightSeg improves both first-pass and final guideline-consistent segmentation performance while requiring fewer refinement steps, demonstrating that multi-agent refinement can become more accurate and efficient by drawing on past correction experience.
papers.summary_zh: 针对多智能体细化系统在语义分割中无状态、重复犯错的问题，提出了InsightSeg，一种情景记忆机制，将成功的修正过程转化为可复用的、视觉上可定位的洞察。元分析器将每个合格的修正过程提炼为指令性的自然语言洞察，并使用补丁级视觉概念向量将其锚定到导致错误的局部图像区域。在后续图像上，这些概念与密集的补丁嵌入进行匹配以检索相关洞察，从而在分割智能体进行首次预测前对其进行条件约束。在Waymo和Cityscapes数据集上，InsightSeg在减少细化步骤的同时，提高了首次预测和最终符合准则的分割性能。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究展示了通过记忆和复用过去的修正经验，可以将多智能体系统从被动纠错转变为主动预防错误，从而在提高精度的同时降低计算成本，这对构建更高效、更智能的自动化地理空间分析系统具有借鉴意义。

papers.title: Federated Multi-Task Learning for Bladder Tumor Segmentation and MIBC Classification Using a Hybrid CNN-Transformer Architecture
papers.title_zh: 基于混合CNN-Transformer架构的膀胱肿瘤分割和MIBC分类联邦多任务学习
papers.reason: 该研究提出了一种联邦多任务学习框架，结合混合CNN-Transformer架构进行医学图像分割和分类，其解决跨机构数据隐私和泛化问题的思路与城市更新中多源数据融合和分布式计算高度相关。
papers.abstract: Accurate bladder tumor segmentation and assessment of mus- cle invasion from T2-weighted MRI are important for treatment plan- ning, but developing robust models across institutions is challenging be- cause patient data cannot be centrally pooled and imaging characteristics vary across scanners and acquisition protocols. We propose a federated multi-task learning framework for joint bladder tumor segmentation and MIBC/NMIBC classification across four clinical centers. The proposed Swin Hybrid model combines a ResNet-34 branch for local texture and boundary information with a Swin-Tiny Transformer for global anatomi- cal context. A segmentation-guided classification mechanism further uses tumor localization information to support MIBC prediction. We also investigate several augmentation strategies under both centralized and federated training to improve robustness to multi-center variability. Ex- periments on the FedBCa dataset show that the Swin Hybrid provides the best overall balance between segmentation and classification among the evaluated architectures. Under federated training, Geo+Elastic aug- mentation achieved a DSC of 0.8100 and a patient-level AUC of 0.8931, yielding the highest combined score of 0.8474. These results demonstrate that joint segmentation and classification can be effectively performed across multiple institutions using federated training without centralizing patient data.
papers.summary_zh: 提出了一种联邦多任务学习框架，用于在四个临床中心联合进行膀胱肿瘤分割和MIBC/NMIBC分类。所提出的Swin Hybrid模型结合了用于局部纹理和边界信息的ResNet-34分支与用于全局解剖上下文的Swin-Tiny Transformer。分割引导的分类机制利用肿瘤定位信息来支持MIBC预测。在集中式和联邦训练下研究了多种增强策略以提高对多中心变异的鲁棒性。在FedBCa数据集上的实验表明，Swin Hybrid在分割和分类之间提供了最佳的整体平衡。在联邦训练下，Geo+Elastic增强实现了0.8100的DSC和0.8931的患者级AUC，产生了最高的综合得分0.8474。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究表明，联邦学习能够在不集中患者数据的情况下，有效联合多个机构训练复杂的多任务模型，其混合架构和增强策略的设计经验可应用于城市尺度上跨部门、跨区域的地理空间数据建模与知识共享。

papers.title: Detect Before You Attribute: Cascade Failure Attribution for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: 先检测后归因：多智能体系统的级联故障归因
papers.reason: 该研究直接针对LLM-based多智能体系统的级联故障归因问题，提出检测-归因范式，与用户研究兴趣中的LLM和多智能体高度契合，且方法具有通用性，可应用于地理空间任务中的多智能体协作。
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have shown strong potential in solving complex tasks through multi-step reasoning, yet they remain vulnerable to execution failures. Accurate failure attribution is therefore critical for improving agent reliability. Existing topology- and spectrum-based methods exploit trajectory structures but often overlook fine-grained semantics, while LLM-based attribution methods capture semantic cues but suffer from long-context degradation over lengthy trajectories. To address these challenges, we propose DUOTRACE, a plug-and-play detection filter for LLM-based failure attribution. DUOTRACE follows a detect-before-attribute paradigm: it first detects anomalous executions and then supplies focused trajectory evidence to downstream LLM-based attribution methods. For effective VAE-based anomaly detection on agent trajectories, DUOTRACE integrates dual-view semantic-structural node representations, a Tree-LSTM-based trajectory encoder, and prefix-chain- and LLM-based data augmentation to handle heterogeneous nodes, hierarchical execution structures, and limited failure data. Experiments with six LLM-based attribution baselines show that DUOTRACE improves agent-level and step-level attribution accuracy by 8.7% and 7.0%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh: 论文提出DUOTRACE，一种即插即用的检测过滤器，用于增强基于LLM的故障归因方法。它遵循“先检测后归因”范式，首先检测异常执行，然后为下游归因方法提供聚焦的轨迹证据。DUOTRACE集成了双视图语义-结构节点表示、基于Tree-LSTM的轨迹编码器以及数据增强技术，以处理异构节点、层级执行结构和有限的故障数据。实验表明，该方法在智能体级和步骤级归因准确率上分别提升了8.7%和7.0%。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提出的“先检测后归因”范式，对于提升地理空间任务中复杂多智能体系统的可靠性和可解释性具有重要参考价值，尤其是在处理长轨迹和复杂执行结构时。

papers.title: A Reproducible Method for Mapping Electricity Transmission Infrastructure for Space Weather Risk Assessment
papers.title_zh: 一种可复现的电力传输基础设施测绘方法用于空间天气风险评估
papers.reason: 该论文直接涉及地理空间数据（OSM）的采集、处理和建模，用于电力基础设施的风险评估，属于GIS应用和空间数据挖掘范畴，与城市更新和基础设施韧性研究高度相关。
papers.abstract: Space weather risk assessment is constrained by the lack of available asset information needed to model geomagnetically induced currents (GICs) in electricity transmission infrastructure. We propose a systematic method that enables risk analysts to collect their own open-source substation data. Using a web browser platform for annotation, we convert OpenStreetMap (OSM) substation locations into high-resolution, component-level mappings of electricity transmission assets. We convert an initial 1,313 high-voltage (>=230 kV) substations to 52,273 components using low-altitude, satellite, and Street View imagery accessed through Google Earth, identifying 7,949 transformers. Compared to the OSM baseline, this approach provides detailed insights on voltage levels and substation configurations. We then construct a geospatial GIC network for the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) region, comparing May 2024 results with the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign 150-bus (UIUC150) synthetic network and with measured ground GICs at 13 monitoring devices. The transformer types at unannotated substations and the grounding resistances are unknown, so we sample both across a Monte Carlo ensemble. This gives a median TVA 95th-percentile peak ground GIC of 29.1 A, with a 90 percent confidence interval of 23.9-36.1 A. The UIUC150 network yields a 95th-percentile peak ground GIC of 35.8 A under the same forcing, falling within this interval, and the modeled time series broadly capture the temporal morphology of the geomagnetic storm at the monitoring sites. This method shows promise for spatially explicit, screening-level GIC assessment without requiring access to operator data.
papers.summary_zh: 针对空间天气风险评估中缺乏资产数据的问题，提出一种系统方法，使风险分析师能够自行收集开源变电站数据。利用网络浏览器平台进行标注，将OpenStreetMap（OSM）中的变电站位置转换为高分辨率、组件级的电力传输资产地图。通过Google Earth获取的影像，将1,313个高压变电站转换为52,273个组件，识别出7,949台变压器。基于此构建田纳西河谷管理局（TVA）区域的地磁感应电流（GIC）地理空间网络，并与合成网络及实测数据对比，验证了该方法在无需运营商数据情况下进行空间显式、筛选级GIC评估的有效性。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究展示了如何利用开放数据和众包平台构建高分辨率基础设施地图，为城市关键基础设施的风险评估提供了可复现的范式。其组件级建模和蒙特卡洛不确定性分析思路，可推广至城市生命线系统的脆弱性评估。
